question: In which of the following years did India host the Asian Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1951 and 1982**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India hosted the Asian Games for the first time in **1951** in New Delhi.
 
• The 1951 Asian Games were the inaugural edition of the event.
 
• India hosted the Asian Games for the second time in **1982**, again in New Delhi.
 
• The 1982 Asian Games witnessed the introduction of the mascot "Appu," which gained significant popularity.
 
• Both the events were significant milestones in India's sports history and contributed to the development of sports infrastructure in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Asian Games**

 
 
• The Asian Games, also known as Asiad, is a continental multi-sport event held every four years among athletes from all over Asia.
 
• The Games are regulated by the Olympic Council of Asia (OCA) under the supervision of the International Olympic Committee (IOC).
 
• The first edition of the Asian Games was held in New Delhi, India, in 1951.
 
• The event has grown in size and importance over the years and now features a wide range of sports and disciplines.
 
 
 
• **New Delhi**
 
 
• New Delhi is the capital city of India and has hosted several international sports events, including the Asian Games and the Commonwealth Games.
 
• The city boasts various sports facilities and stadiums, such as the Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium and the Indira Gandhi Arena.
 
 
 
• **Appu**
 
 
• "Appu" was the mascot of the 1982 Asian Games held in New Delhi.
 
• Appu was a depiction of an elephant, symbolizing strength and wisdom, and became a beloved character associated with the event.
